verdict.rationale: The only MCP-related evidence (twenty-docs-32, pricing table listing 'MCP server: Yes') indicates Twenty exposes an MCP server for others to connect to, not that Twenty's AI agents can consume external MCP servers as tool providers. There is no documentation of configuring or plugging third-party MCP servers into Twenty's agents to extend their tool access. Missing for 10: any docs/UI for adding external MCP server connections to Twenty's AI agents, and evidence those agents can invoke tools from such servers.
